title: Exchange rates and external balances
review_type: Author audit and independent computation, submitted for root acceptance

checks: Three worked examples, eight full solutions, answered retention, five scoped primary sources and four flat downloads
Exact transaction rows, GDP/saving bridge, discrepancy signs, gross position and NFA reconciliations
Principal revaluation before interest, exact PPP growth and quote inversion, independent exercise anchors
Two funded covered strategies, exact expected uncovered returns, reciprocal expectation and executable bid/ask bounds
Original money-demand, central-bank balance-sheet, equity, parity and regime-feasibility residuals
Preserved output, quiet import/run, strict JSON, arbitrary-CWD CLI, valid gross-position/expectation mutations and invalid API/CLI rejection
limitations: Checks concern original maintained synthetic models, not empirical identification, executable current market opportunities or a forecast.
The full prose and economic assumptions require editorial audit; the two spread inequalities are not a universal market completeness test.
No visual/mobile/print QA, external human certification, shared acceptance or publication is claimed.

prose_and_proof_audit: Resident versus nonresident scope and current/capital/financial distinctions are explicit. Every original transaction row balances. Acquisition and liability-incurrence columns have separately defined positive signs; SD = FA - CA - KA is checked against both complete and inconsistent observed records.

Saving-current-account bridge is derived with G government consumption and I all gross investment, including public investment. Capital transfers enter net lending separately. Principal repayment and earned interest are separated; no identity is asserted to identify a causal mechanism or welfare ranking.

Separate asset/liability stock reconciliations prove the NFA bridge. Event-date transaction conversion, unchanged-principal valuation, end-date accrued interest and residence reclassification have distinct entries. Currency and gross/maturity exposures are not inferred from the aggregate NFA alone.

Home-currency-per-foreign quote is fixed before use. Law of one price and common-basket aggregation provide explicit sufficient conditions for absolute PPP. Real-rate changes, relative PPP, exact finite depreciation, inverse quotes and independently rebased CPI levels are separated.

Covered parity is derived from two financed, maturity-matched, fully hedged paths under stated default/access/cost assumptions. Both arbitrage directions and bid/ask funding inequalities are independently recomputed. Positive gross factors permit negative net deposit rates in the generic parity exercise; this does not import the later freely storable currency assumption.

Uncovered returns use an explicit two-state conditional distribution. Expected excess return is a definition; UIP is an additional restriction, not an implication of CIP or capital mobility alone. Reciprocal expectations and downside loss are checked. Risk-neutral home-currency payoffs are distinguished from real consumption payoffs under uncertain prices; the full asset-pricing derivation is deferred.

Original instantaneous regime model closes money demand, central-bank balance sheet, reserve valuation in equity and parity. Commercial banks are absent. Float expectation is supplied, not inferred from the current purchase. Unique conditional solutions and global nonnegative-reserve and positive-money/nonnegative-rate domains are explicit; policy failure is not silently clipped into an equilibrium.

Three complete worked examples, all eight exercise/solution pairs and retention answers are independently recomputed. Open empirical-design solution names the estimand, timing, identifying comparison, anticipation/concurrent-policy/spillover threats and imperfect diagnostics. Grading criteria assess reasoning rather than a preferred policy.

Five scoped primary sources were actually inspected. BPM7 means the specifically inspected March 2025 white-cover/pre-edited text; the official release and recommended country implementation dates are distinguished. Exact inspection locations are preserved in the source proposals. Historical numerical findings and current exchange-rate observations are not imported.

Canonical predecessor c10 and now-written successor c12 are directly linked. Download links are flat filenames, code is standard-library-only and offline, default paths resolve independently of the current working directory, and supplied output is exact and reproducible.

resolved_authoring_issues.issue: Root requested that the money aggregate and expectation closure be explicit.
resolved_authoring_issues.resolution: The model uses directly held currency/base with no commercial banks, a supplied terminal conditional mean and no automatic implication from current monetary expansion.

resolved_authoring_issues.issue: Global extrapolation could incorrectly permit negative reserves or negative nominal rates with freely storable currency.
resolved_authoring_issues.resolution: Both manuscript and executable distinguish admissible boundaries from infeasible candidates; peg D = 95 and float D = 60 are checked alongside violations.

resolved_authoring_issues.issue: The exact IMF edition and old-to-new terminology require actual manual inspection rather than a generic BPM6 reference.
resolved_authoring_issues.resolution: Inspected BPM7 title, accounting/valuation/interest passages and terminology tables; retained explicitly dated white-cover scope, implementation distinction, and precise printed-page references.

limitations: Checks concern original maintained synthetic models, not empirical identification, executable current market opportunities or a forecast.
The full prose and economic assumptions require editorial audit; the two spread inequalities are not a universal market completeness test.
No visual/mobile/print QA, external human certification, shared acceptance or publication is claimed.
Source inspection is scoped to the listed passages, not verification of the entire IMF manual, every author slide, every national dataset or actual country adoption.

The monetary regime model fixes contemporaneous prices/output, treats domestic securities at a fixed price and supplies the future conditional mean. It proves no infinite-horizon equilibrium, credibility, optimal currency regime or identified policy effect.
No full stochastic-discount-factor theorem, empirical parity estimate, actual trading opportunity or current country forecast is claimed.
acceptance: Complete authored package submitted for review. Root retains dependency-order acceptance, central integration and publication.
